seoTitle: How to Use a Gift Card on eBay Checkout
metaDescription: Learn how to redeem an eBay gift card at checkout, check your remaining balance, and avoid common errors on the website or mobile app.
intro: Whether you received an eBay gift card by email or have a physical card, applying it at checkout is straightforward once you know the steps. This guide covers redeeming the code, checking your balance, and avoiding common issues like expired or region-locked cards.

steps.heading: Enter your gift card code
steps.body: During checkout, enter the 16-digit gift card code in the payment section to redeem it.

steps.heading: Confirm the deduction
steps.body: The gift card value is deducted from your total purchase amount, and any remaining amount is charged to your other payment method.

steps.heading: Check your remaining balance
steps.body: If your card has leftover value, you can check the remaining balance for use on a future purchase.

steps.heading: Use it on auctions or Buy It Now listings
steps.body: Gift cards work across both auction-style and Buy It Now listings in most categories.

steps.heading: Follow the same steps on mobile
steps.body: The redemption process is the same in the eBay mobile app as it is on the website.

steps.heading: Avoid common errors
steps.body: Watch for issues like expired cards, region-lock errors, or conflicts with other payment methods like PayPal or credit cards.

faq.question: How do I redeem an eBay gift card?
faq.answer: Enter the 16-digit code during checkout in the payment section to apply it toward your order total.

faq.question: What happens if my order costs more than my gift card?
faq.answer: The gift card value is deducted from the total, and the remaining balance is charged to your other selected payment method.

faq.question: Can I check my remaining gift card balance?
faq.answer: Yes, you can check the leftover balance on your gift card for use on future purchases.

faq.question: Can I use a gift card on the eBay app?
faq.answer: Yes, the same redemption steps apply whether you're using the eBay website or the mobile app.

faq.question: Why isn't my gift card working?
faq.answer: Common causes include an expired card, a region-lock error, or a conflict with another payment method during checkout.
